samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative-generation task (inventing a problem setup). Petrel matches or beats Plover on all relevant evals and lacks Plover's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work, making it the better fit for an invent-and-solve request.

This is an open-ended creative generation task (inventing a problem from scratch) combined with a solve step. Petrel matches or leads Plover on every relevant eval (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7, MMLU-Pro and Arena-Hard notably higher), and Plover self-reports an aversion to high-latitude generative work like this. Neither preference affects quality, but Petrel is the stronger and better-suited fit.
